payload.title: The forum on Shipped: posting on items and Stories, AI moderation, first live reader post
payload.description:
Repo: **Shipped-web** (config, page, hooks) with Papyrus features from the forum tasks. The forum on Shipped: readers (already signing in through Prospectus for votes, submissions, comments) read and post in threads on items, Stories and proposals.

## Change
1. `web/projection.json` `homePage.forum.posting: {enabled: true, subjects: ["story", "reference"], moderation: "ai"}`; `papyrus.config.ts` reader-steering `moderation: {mode: "ai"}` (today `human`; Ryan's default is AI moderation; the human queue stays as the review surface). Note the change on ship-d02e82.
2. Item comments: after the one-Message-model task and the backfill (run by Ryan, dry-run count first), `hooks.py` `_item_comments_html` mounts the forum island (`forum-thread`, subject `story`/item) instead of the reader `Comments` island; the Comments island stays available for one release.
3. `web/pages/conversations.md` is NOT needed: the forum index is generated at `/<threadBase>/`; add it to Shipped's nav (`homePage.forum.navLabel: "Conversations"`) and to `web/pages/newsroom.md`.
4. Verify live after deploy with a real Google account of Ryan's choosing: sign in, pick a handle, post on an item, see it at once, see it on the static page after the debounce window; an admin removes it from the console; the page shows "Message removed". This is the first-use evidence ship-378fcc / ship-b35fa2 / ship-d02e82 have been waiting for; record it on those Shipped stories and close them if their criteria are met. Depends on bug PPY-05cf41 (reader sign-in failing after the code exchange) being fixed first.

## Gherkin (Shipped-web tests + the Papyrus features already written by the forum tasks)
  Scenario: Shipped's item page mounts the forum island with the item as subject
  Scenario: The Conversations entry appears in Shipped's nav

## Acceptance
Live post by a reader on shipped.anth.us; moderation path exercised; Shipped board stories updated. Blocked by: forum posting task, forum island task, one-Message-model task, PPY-05cf41, and the Shipped public-pages task.
